data.long_description:
We proudly present this stunning 3 bedroom corner Penthouse at One Canal by AHS Properties located at Dubai Water Canal and Safa Park in between Jumeirah 1 and 2.


  The penthouse is located at the first floor which gives you the perfect angle of the water flowing through the canal. Catch the reflection of the sunrays touching the calming water after a long day of work.


  Be dazzled the moment you enter the grand living and dining area, you are welcomed by panoramic floor to ceiling windows. The oversized windows let in abundance of natural daylight, which gives the penthouse the absolute wow factor.


  Enjoy your private temperature controlled swimming pool in full privacy.


  The master bedroom features stunning views of Safa Park and gives access to your private terrace with plunge pool. All 3 bedrooms feature a private ensuite bathroom to ensure full privacy for all family members.
